proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12045 The vīṭā article explicitly distinguishes Gujarati vīṭī ring under *vīṭṭa and vĩṭī ring under *viṇṭa. These Bhil viṭi/vĩṭi forms follow those Gujarati comparisons; both unnumbered subfamilies remain under the existing article node, with nasal variation preserved. Exact survey form viṭi is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
